sentences.en: I bought an electronic dictionary to help me learn new words.
sentences.zh: 我买了一个电子词典来帮助我学习新单词。

sentences.en: The electronic dictionaries in the store are really helpful for students like you.
sentences.zh: 店里那些电子词典对你们这些学生真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: She uses her electronic dictionary to look up words while reading books.
sentences.zh: 她读书时用电子词典查单词。
